title: StandInSpec
description: Everything needed to draw a watch at its true size without brand marks: the outline, the layers seen from above, and the colours. The 2.5-D renderer, the 3-D stand-in for live AR and the synthetic data generator all draw from it. Lengths are nominal; their uncertainty lives in the catalogue.

spec_version.description: The version of this specification format

assumed.description: Dimensions filled with a default rather than from a measurement or a cited source, as 'section.field' paths (for example 'lugs.lug_to_lug_mm'). A render that depends on one says so. Colours, finish and markings are always approximate in a stand-in and are never listed.

diameter_mm.description: Across the case body from 9 to 3 o'clock, without the crown

length_mm.description: The case body from 12 to 6 o'clock, without the lugs. Equal to diameter_mm for a round case

squareness.description: Exponent of the superellipse that draws the outline: 2 is a circle or an ellipse, about 4 a cushion, 8 or more a square with small rounded corners

taper.description: Width at the 12 and 6 o'clock ends relative to the middle: 1 for most cases, about 0.8 for a tonneau

thickness_mm.description: From the case back to the top of the crystal

crystal_dome_mm.description: How far the crystal rises above the bezel or case top; 0 for a flat crystal

finish.description: How the case surface reflects light

outer_mm.description: Outer width of the bezel or top ring from 9 to 3 o'clock; null when there is no separate bezel

colour.description: The bezel's own colour; null when there is no separate bezel

insert_colour.description: Colour of a rotating bezel's insert; null for other bezels

markings.description: A generic scale drawn on the bezel. Never text or logos

opening_mm.description: Width of the visible dial opening (the inner edge of the bezel or case) from 9 to 3 o'clock. The opening follows the case outline's shape

index_style.description: Generic hour markers. Never text or logos

lug_to_lug_mm.description: From the tip of the upper lugs to the tip of the lower lugs, along 12 to 6 o'clock

lug_width_mm.description: Inside distance between the lugs, where the strap fits

style.description: 'integrated' when the strap or bracelet joins the case without separate lugs

length_mm.description: How far the crown stands out from the case

guards.description: Whether the case has crown guards

width_at_buckle_mm.description: Strap width at the buckle or clasp; equal to the lug width when it doesn't taper
